screenshots_note: Play listing com.barknativeshop: 8 vertical 1080x2340 screenshots + one 512x512 tile (see brands/barkbox/screenshots/). App UI screenshots with marketing text.
needs_human: The logo is a trademark of BARK. Commons marks the file public domain but Restrictions: trademarked - not permission to use the mark in a creative. Blocked on the brand approval policy (PROJECT.md 13).

BarkBox vs BARK: the website, YouTube channel ('BARK', @BarkBox), Instagram/Facebook/TikTok are now mostly the parent BARK brand; BarkBox is the product line sold on bark.co. A BarkBox-specific mark exists (not just the parent), so the creative uses the BarkBox mark.
Press kit not found on bark.co/blogs/press or investors.bark.co ('not found', not 'blocked'). www.barkbox.com itself returns 403.
YouTube channel verification not reported by yt-dlp (NA); channel accepted on the strength of the bark.co footer link only.
Brand font not available; fallback font will be used.
Instagram/TikTok need a logged-in session to collect; not attempted.

decisions.decision: Use the Commons BarkBox 'BARK<BOX' wordmark (logo.png_url) for creatives; the newer bark.co mark has no PNG >= 1600 px.
